pattern: Scrollable region (WCAG 2.1.1): a scrollable element that holds no focusable content must itself be focusable and named; it is a region with aria-label while it overflows.

roles.role: region while overflowing when it is a generic div or span; otherwise its own role (a list stays a list)

aria.value: 0 while overflowing (an existing tabindex is kept)

keyboard.action: Moves to the region while its content overflows.

keyboard.key: Arrow keys / Page Up / Page Down / Home / End / Space

focus: Focusable only while there is something to scroll; the focus ring is drawn with the fades off.
notes: The fades are a visual hint only; screen-reader users reach all content in reading order.
No custom scrollbars: the platform scrollbar, including its high-contrast and accessibility settings, is kept.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
